test_case_results.title: Page should consist of an HTML heading element with text content as "Count 0" initially
Page should consist of an HTML button element with text content as "Increment"
Page should consist of an HTML paragraph element with text content as "Count is Even" initially
Page should consist of an HTML paragraph element with text content as "*Increase By Random Number Between 0 to 100"
When the Increment button is clicked, the count should be greater than or equal to the previous count
When the Increment button is clicked, the count should be increased and the HTML heading element should consist of the increased count
When the Increment button is clicked, the count should be increased and "Count is Even" text should be displayed if the count is even
When the Increment button is clicked, the count should be increased and "Count is Odd" text should be displayed if the count is odd
